stem:
Three processes that are required for sexual reproduction to occur are shown.

Which table most accurately describes the importance of each process to sexual reproduction?

options.label: A
options.text:
Process 1 Exchange of genetic material
Process 2 Produces haploid cells
Process 3 Produces a diploid cell

options.label: B
options.text:
Process 1 Produces haploid cells
Process 2 Produces diploid cells
Process 3 Exchange of genetic material

options.label: C
options.text:
Process 1 Produces diploid cells
Process 2 Produces haploid cells
Process 3 Exchange of genetic material

options.label: D
options.text:
Process 1 Exchange of genetic material
Process 2 Produces diploid cells
Process 3 Produces a haploid cell

visual_elements:
Diagram showing: Process 1 as paired chromosomes with crossover,
Process 2 as chromosomes segregating into 4 haploid cells,
Process 3 as sperm fertilizing egg
